product_metadata.title: Twin/Twin XL Foam Mattress Vacuum Bag for Moving, Vacuum Seal Mattress Storage Bag with Straps
features: No More Hassle Moving Mattress: Our vacuum mattress bag is a must-have packing supply for mattress transportation and storage. You can vacuum and move mattresses just by yourself. With our mattress bag, moving mattress is no longer a challenge!

80% Compression Ratio: Compress your mattress down to a fraction of its size. Rolled up vacuumed mattress easily fits in a car/back of SUV/shipping box. Our mattress compression bag works with vacuum cleaners. Binding straps included.
Leakproof & Sealable: Our mattress space bag adopts extra thick & durable premium grade PA+PE material prevents punctures and serves as mattress protector from air, dust, dirt.

Featured Double-Zip & Stay-on Clip: Our unique Double-Zip seal is designed to get air out in the vacuum process and ensures lasting compression. Stay-on clip ensures that the clips does not fall off the zipper or missing.
Precise-sized Bag Dimension: Designed for twin and twin-xl sized mattress with up to18-inch thickness. The transparent clear bag makes it easy to find and identify mattress.
